description: Looping 'fusion' boot animation made from the EmuFusion app icon. The icon is separated by colour (six rainbow arms of the swirl, the dark D-pad body, the light button body); the layers circle as twisted rings of liquid light, contract and unwind, and lock into the exact icon in a flash with a chromatic shockwave. The icon then floats in god rays with orbiting comets and the wordmark, and finally spins into a point of light that seeds the next loop.
renderScript: render.py (deterministic; Homebrew python3 + numpy + Pillow + OpenCV, ffmpeg/libx264). render_all.sh renders lossless segments in parallel and encodes ../../loading.mp4.
wordmarkFont: Roboto Light (Apache 2.0) from the Android SDK platform fonts
loop: Seamless: mean absolute change from the last frame to the first is 1.75, below the median consecutive-frame change of 2.0. The largest change is the intended fusion flash at frame 101.
runtimeBehavior: Unchanged: BootVideoOverlay extracts the content-addressed asset, loops it, fits it without cropping, and dismisses it when the library is ready.
